title: What we do
text: From a single page to automating your whole business.

items.title: Landing page
items.text: One page that sells one thing. Fast and to the point.

items.title: Catalog website
items.text: All your products with photos, prices and filters.

items.title: Business website
items.text: A few pages about you, your services and contacts. With an admin panel.

items.title: Online store
items.text: Cart, card payments, delivery. Sells while you sleep.

items.title: Redesign
items.text: Your old website in a new look. Easy to use and fast.

items.title: Support
items.text: Updates, edits and backups. You run your business.

items.title: Automation & integrations
items.text: Leads go to your CRM, reports go to spreadsheets. The system does the routine.

items.title: Telegram bots
items.text: Take orders, answer clients, send reminders.

items.title: Branding & design
items.text: Logo, colours, style — so people remember you.

items.title: Custom project
items.text: Not on the list? Tell us the task — we'll estimate it.
